For other uses, see Galene (disambiguation).

Galene is a Non-Playable Character (NPC) in the Glitch in the Heart storyline.

sections.title: In-Game Appearance
sections.content: Galene’s first and only appearance is in Glitch in the Heart.

sections.title: As a unit
sections.content: See Galene and VLKR Sentienel Galene

sections.title: BF Comic Series
sections.content:
Galene makes only one appearance in the BF Comic Series. In the fifty-eighth episode of the comic series, Galene is showcased along with Vektor being outnumbered by surrounding enemies. Without much effort, Galene manages to take down the enemies while Vektor is left with serious injuries.

Galene appears in the following episodes of the BF Comic Series:
- BF Comic 058: Did my best

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - The name "Galene" is said to mean "calm sea."

==Non-Canon Appearances==
===[[BF Comic Series]]===
[[File:Galene BFComicSeries.PNG|thumb|150px|Galene in the BF Comic Series]]
Galene makes only one appearance in the BF Comic Series. In the fifty-eighth episode of the comic series, Galene is showcased along with [[Vektor (character)|Vektor]] being outnumbered by surrounding enemies. Without much effort, Galene manages to take down the enemies while Vektor is left with serious injuries.

Galene appears in the following episodes of the BF Comic Series:
*[[BF Comic:058|BF Comic 058: Did my best]]
